GPU-free implementation; GPU case ignored until G-L2/G-L1 reference exists.

tests/render_per_world_light.rs.role: entity: reference npz decode/load (raw f32 rgb kept for C1 + quantized bytes for A), capture provenance self-check, [ignore] GPU case (A/B/C + two-run sha + world isolation), ignored local pilot C1 cross-check

dump_provenance.model_file_note: dump `model_file` is a name string only; the .mjb is generated under target/ and not committed, so the field does not identify a committed file.

criteria_implementation.criterion_a: two cameras x three worlds strict bit-level: rgb max_byte_diff==0 & mismatched_pixels==0; depth bit-equal mismatched==0 & beyond_ulp==0; seg (id,type) equal; no allowlist / no tolerance
criteria_implementation.criterion_b: reference state.npz light_xpos/light_xdir f32 bits vs product-side WorldLightPoses (bit-verbatim pass-through, no FK/f64/re-normalization): 0 exceptions
criteria_implementation.criterion_c: reference-side self-computed: C1 cam-persp adjacent-world raw-f32 max_channel|dRGB| >= 1/255 px count (f32 diffs promoted to f64; bit-identical to G-L0 readout_c1_c2.py; byte-quantized |dbyte| >= 1 is NOT used; 254<->255-class adjacent-code steps are not counted); C2 cam-hinge depth bit-changed + seg pair-changed px count; thresholds ACCEPT=384 / MARGIN=576; pairs [(0,1),(1,2)]; camera attribution fixed (C1=cam0/cam-persp, C2=cam1/cam-hinge); diagnostics recorded only
criteria_implementation.verdict: any <384 -> NonDiscriminating; any <576 -> Insufficient; else PassMargin
criteria_implementation.two_run_sha: sha256 of rgb/depth/seg buffers across two product renders must be equal
criteria_implementation.world_isolation: change world1 geometry + light poses only: world0/world2 both cameras bit-identical, world1 at least one camera changes; not a substitute for A/B/C
criteria_implementation.gating: GPU case #[ignore]; forced --ignored run panics explicitly with 'not executed: reference missing (G-L1 capture pending)' (no silent skip); G-L2 frozen exe runs it for real
criteria_implementation.capture_provenance: values vs spec §2.1/§2.2 (cam-persp/cam-hinge mode/fovy/resolution/pos/quat-normalized/sensorsize/intrinsic, scene sha256+bytes), command.argv shape, per_world_scope covers light+geom (string/list normalized like readout scope_text), resolved nworld/nrender/cam_id_map/cam_res/cam_active/legacy entries, optional C1 == capture-recorded C1
